text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yesterday, Mayano and I were watching this thriller series she's been getting into.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We were just gonna watch one episode, but Mayano said she figured out who the culprit was, and at the end of the episode it turned out she was right.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So of course I wanted to try my hand at guessing too. And we got so into the whole thing, guessing culprit after culprit…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We ended up watching the whole series. Yawn…
